schema: §2.7 (v0.50) -- complete per-sentence segment disposition, superseding §21 R6's not_annotatable-only shape. `not_annotatable` (R6's original array, the only key run_scoring.load_not_annotatable() reads) is preserved for scoring and holds every NOT_OBLIGATION_BEARING / NOT_ANNOTATABLE / EXCLUDED span. `dispositions` is the full per-sentence record §2.7 requires, covering ANNOTATED and AMBIGUOUS spans too, which `not_annotatable` deliberately excludes -- an AMBIGUOUS span is an open reviewer question, not a settled non-item, and including it in the scoring array would resolve it silently.

reconciliation.note: All sentences accounted for; obligation-bearing clause count matches items_annotated exactly.

dispositions.span_text: It shall ensure that the DC is clean and maintains certification from all applicable regulators.
dispositions.reason: 'It' has no antecedent anywhere in this segment (it is the segment's first word) and cannot forward-reference 'NFI' in the next sentence -- a genuine external-dependency failure under §2.6's own test ('does the sentence need something from outside the segment'), reviewer-confirmed. A real party (NFI) would resolve this if the antecedent were available, so it counts as obligation-bearing content, structurally disqualified -- same shape as E03-005's cross-reference-dependent 'discuss' clause, not the same shape as a genuinely non-party subject. Already reasoned, unprompted, in E08-01's own annotator_notes.
